query:
SELECT
            id,
            actor_user_id,
            target_user_id,
            action,
            result,
            created_at
         FROM admin_audit_events
         WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR action = $1)
           AND ($2::text IS NULL OR result = $2)
           AND (
                $3::timestamptz IS NULL
                OR $4::uuid IS NULL
                OR (created_at, id) < ($3, $4)
           )
         ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
         LIMIT $5
